mapper.sql: t.id, t.name, t.content, t.signature_id, t.status, t.remark, t.create_time, t.update_time, s.content AS signature_content
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ink_template t LEFT JOIN ink_signature s ON t.signature_id = s.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ink_template (name, content, signature_id, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{content}, #{signatureId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE ink_template SET name = #{name}, content = #{content}, signature_id = #{signatureId}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ink_template SET status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
